title: D+D=T // THE TIME-TRAVELING FETUS OF MEEREEN
narrative: Mirri Maz Duur draws a glowing quantum chalkboard inside the blood-magic tent. "Listen closely, Daenerys! When Rhaego died in your womb, the blood magic did not kill him. It bent the space-time continuum backwards through a gravitational wormhole, depositing him forty years earlier into Joanna Lannister's uterus! You are not Tyrion's aunt—you are his biological mother!" Tyrion waddles in holding a goblet of Dornish red, blinking through his mismatched eyes. "Well," he sighs. "That explains why I like fire and have terrible parent issues."

options.text: Build a dragon saddle capable of supersonic time-dilation.
Confront Euron Greyjoy, who is simultaneously Daario Naharis and Benjen Stark.
options.introducesPlotHole: The Triple Quantum Superposition of Daario/Euron/Benjen
